turn.text:
Set up SSL VPN so remote staff log in with username+password, get an internal IP from pool 10.9.9.0/24, and can reach intranet server 10.1.0.50.

Site notes: fw's public address is 203.0.113.2 (eth2); the intranet (10.1.0.0/16, server 10.1.0.50) is on eth1. ocserv is installed with its default config /etc/ocserv/ocserv.conf (plain password file /etc/ocserv/passwd); the server certificate is /lab/keys/vpn.pem with key /lab/keys/vpn.key. Create the VPN account `staff` with password Rem0te-Pass. The device has no systemd: start daemons directly.
Plan: printf 'Rem0te-Pass\nRem0te-Pass\n' | ocpasswd -c /etc/ocserv/passwd staff; sed -i -e 's#^ipv4-network = .*#ipv4-network = 10.9.9.0#' -e 's#^server-cert = .*#server-cert = /lab/keys/vpn.pem#' -e 's#^server-key = .*#server-key = /lab/keys/vpn.key#' -e '/^ca-cert = /d' -e '/^dns = /d' -e '/^route = /d' /etc/ocserv/ocserv.conf; echo 'route = 10.1.0.0/255.255.0.0' >> /etc/ocserv/ocserv.conf; ocserv -c /etc/ocserv/ocserv.conf
